selected_branches.branch: (c) Official traffic-control device directs lamp use
required_context: Establish an ordinary motor vehicle, Nevada jurisdiction and a highway with public dedication, boundaries and public vehicular access.
Realize a supported sign explicitly directing lamp use; establish public-authority placement, qualification under NRS 484A.145, governed route and operative timing.
Keep ego traveling and document parking/loading circumstances without assuming a parked-vehicle exception.
Retain date, location, clock basis, sunset and sunrise context and available visibility evidence.
Obtain applicable class-specific lamp provisions and actual states of all required illuminating devices before claiming complete equipment evidence.

law_text: Every vehicle upon a highway of this State, subject to exceptions with respect to parked vehicles as stated in chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS, must display lighted lamps and illuminating devices as respectively required in this chapter for different classes of vehicles: (a) At any time from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise; (b) At any other time when, because of insufficient light or unfavorable atmospheric conditions, persons and vehicles on the highway are not clearly discernible at a distance of 1,000 feet ahead; and (c) When directed by an official traffic control device.
